But the rest of the brief undercuts it. The coin is down 94% from its 30-minute high and down 82% over 30 minutes. The sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes after graduation was 0.91, and 38% of curve buying came from bundled wallets. Pool depth is only 55 SOL, so a round trip would cost well above the 1.4% floor.

Demand that is still leaving the coin is not demand that will still be here in 30 to 60 minutes. I see no honest case for buying now. Skip.
